# 地图索引、已检查引用与 ProvinceAtlas

[API 任务入口](../../index.md) · [公开模块](../index.md)

`indexGeography` 从有效世界文件读取省份、地区和战略区域；`ProvinceAtlas` 在这些真实数据上提供查询与路径规划。使用 checked land references 可以在规划前发现海省、缺失省份或错误地区。`ProvinceAtlasError` 是地图输入或查询无法成立时的异常类型，应携带上下文反馈给作者。

地图文件的读取集合由 `WorldFile` 表示，见[有效游戏世界](world.md)。铁路计划与覆盖文件在[铁路页面](railways.md)，与地图数据结构分开以保持页面可读。

## ProvinceAtlas { #provinceatlas }

Defined in: [src/project/atlas.ts:279](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/project/atlas.ts#L279)

Decode province borders once and reuse the index for many land routes.
Only orthogonal pixel contacts count; impassable and conditional special borders are excluded.

### Example { #provinceatlas-section-example }

```ts
const atlas = new ProvinceAtlas(world.effectiveFiles);
const route = atlas.planRailway({ via: [atlas.land(6521), atlas.land(6282)], avoidStates: [65] });
console.log(route.provinces);
```

#### planRailway() { #provinceatlas-section-planrailway }

> **planRailway**(`request`: [`RailwayRouteRequest`](railways.md#railwayrouterequest)): [`PlannedRailwayRoute`](railways.md#plannedrailwayroute)

Defined in: [src/project/atlas.ts:465](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/project/atlas.ts#L465)

Find minimum-border paths between ordered waypoints. Equal choices use ascending province IDs.
Revisited provinces are rejected instead of emitting an invalid native railway loop.

| ------ | ------ |
| `request` | [`RailwayRouteRequest`](railways.md#railwayrouterequest) |

## indexGeography() { #indexgeography }

> **indexGeography**(`files`: `ReadonlyMap`&lt;`string`, [`WorldFile`](world.md#worldfile)&gt;): [`GeographyIndex`](#geographyindex)

Defined in: [src/project/atlas.ts:72](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/project/atlas.ts#L72)
